# Vendored animation libraries

- **GSAP 3.15.1** (`gsap.min.js`)
- **ScrollTrigger 3.15.1** (`ScrollTrigger.min.js`)
- **SplitText 3.15.1** (`SplitText.min.js`)
- **Lenis 1.3.27** (`lenis.min.js`)

## Sources

- GSAP package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.1>
- GSAP repository: <https://github.com/greensock/GSAP>
- Lenis package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/lenis/v/1.3.27>
- Lenis repository: <https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis>

GSAP files are distributed by GreenSock under the GSAP standard “no charge” license. The original license notices are retained at the top of each minified file. See <https://gsap.com/standard-license/> for the license terms.

Lenis is distributed under the MIT license; its license is retained in `LENIS-LICENSE.txt`.

The masked text, aurora, magnetic button and spotlight-card techniques are implemented locally in `cinematic.js` and `motion.css`, taking visual inspiration from <https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits>. No React runtime or React Bits source code is required by this static site.
